preflight.code:
#!/bin/zsh
# preflight.zsh: read what Unreal Engine 5.8 needs from this Mac. It changes nothing.
autoload -Uz is-at-least
engine="/Users/Shared/Epic Games/UE_5.8"
typeset -A tone=(✓ green ! yellow ✗ red)
row() {  # mark, label, what was found
  print -P "%F{${tone[$1]}}$1%f ${(r:16:)2} $3"
}

chip=$(sysctl -n machdep.cpu.brand_string)
if [[ $(uname -m) == arm64 ]]; then row ✓ chip "$chip"
else row ✗ chip "$chip, Epic's minimum is an M1"; fi

ram=$(( $(sysctl -n hw.memsize) / 1073741824 ))
if   (( ram >= 32 )); then row ✓ memory "$ram GB"
elif (( ram >= 16 )); then row ! memory "$ram GB, Epic recommends 32"
else row ✗ memory "$ram GB, Epic's minimum is 16"; fi

os=$(sw_vers -productVersion)
if   ! is-at-least 14.5 $os; then row ✗ macOS "$os, Epic's minimum is 14.5"
elif is-at-least 16 $os;     then row ! macOS "$os, newer than the macOS 15 Epic lists"
else row ✓ macOS "$os"; fi

free=$(df -g /System/Volumes/Data | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')
if (( free >= 100 )); then row ✓ "free disk" "$free GB"
else row ! "free disk" "$free GB, I would want 100"; fi

if [[ -d $engine ]]; then row ✓ engine "$engine"
else row ✗ engine "nothing at $engine"; fi

xc=$(xcodebuild -version 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 {print $2}')
if   [[ -z $xc ]];           then row ✗ Xcode "no full Xcode is selected"
elif ! is-at-least 26.0 $xc; then row ✗ Xcode "$xc, Epic's minimum is 26.0"
elif [[ $xc == 26.4* ]];     then row ✗ Xcode "$xc, which Epic says is not compatible"
elif is-at-least 26.2 $xc;   then row ! Xcode "$xc, newer than the 26.1.1 Epic recommends"
else row ✓ Xcode "$xc"; fi

if metal=$(xcrun -sdk macosx metal -v 2>&1); then row ✓ "Metal toolchain" "${${(f)metal}[1]}"
else row ✗ "Metal toolchain" "missing for this Xcode"; fi
